verdict.rationale: QuickBooks' own docs cover automated payment reminders and statement reminders for late-paying customers, which delivers the overdue-reminder half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents recurring or scheduled invoices; the AI generator and calendar-billing items cover one-off invoice creation, not a recurring schedule. missing for 10: documented recurring invoice scheduling, detail on reminder configuration (timing/cadence for overdue invoices), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Avoid late payments with automated payment reminders.
In just a few clicks you can send statement reminders to customers that are late paying you.
Get paid 4 days faster on average when you send invoice reminders with your Payments AI.
